budget: common exploration bank and matched final gradient/probe budgets; disclose all search, field fitting, runtime fitting and measured execution costs
deployment: actual selected action execution and byte readback; counterfactual action bank forbidden on test/retention deployment
field_prediction: action-specific ridge on constant, state and squared-state coordinates, predicts next reduced field and hard fixed-policy value; fit scaler on training trajectories only
fixed_policy: one strongest action in declared five-action family selected on original model development; identical action reused after every adaptation
gain_acceptance: positive family-adjusted lower endpoint and positive difference for each fixed seed, for both primary reward and independent audit scorer; candidate must also retain versus A
generic_field: fixed seed271027 orthonormal six-dimensional projection of the same train-standardized fourteen diagnostics
independence: paired disjoint base-image pairs within held-out split; conditions and seeds remain paired in bootstrap; intervals conditional on three fixed historical models
interaction_inference: descriptive difference-in-differences with paired 95% interval; no multiplicity-controlled interaction claim
mpc_objective: maximize predicted terminal hard fixed-policy value after two adaptation steps; one step at last boundary; no label-based per-example runtime oracle
optimizer_start: new local adaptation problem initializes SGD momentum at zero explicitly; original pretraining optimizer continuation is not claimed
population_scope: historical public MNIST development; disjoint from named prior test ranges, not a registry-wide never-seen or new-writer claim
primary_intervals: paired source-pair cluster bootstrap, common sampled pairs across seeds/conditions/arms; two-sided Bonferroni six-contrast family
primary_objective: mean hard UTF8/8-bit-PNG reward-observer utility minus 0.002 per actual refinement; common first couple is charged
retention_intervals: separate nine-comparison Bonferroni family versus A_frozen_fixed; no test-retention selection
secondary_ce: one global log-mean-exp over the frozen seed/pair/corruption cohort, not average conditional CE
secondary_observer: independently trained frozen audit observer; never used for fitting or selection
training_controller: empirical finite-action two-step MPC fitted to train-only optimizer trajectories; not Riccati or scalar FBSDE certification
training_value: actual hard decoded reward under the fixed original development-selected action; no per-example oracle maximization
